from.n: replay: a retry while the lease is STILL LIVE keeps answering from the store

to.n: replay: a retry while the lease is STILL HELD keeps answering from the store

from.n: release: deletes the caller's own row and leaves a foreign one alone

to.n: release: frees the caller's own lease and leaves a foreign one alone

from.n: acquire: conditional write — free and expired rows are taken, a live foreign lease is not

to.n: acquire: takes a free space and keeps one's own, and leaves another holder's lease alone

from.n: execution_lease: exactly three fields — the v1 shape's extra columns did not come back

to.n: execution_lease: the stored table stays in the schema, and acquiring and releasing leave it empty

from.n: discipline (C7a): a probe sealed before a lapse a rival claimed never commits — renewal failure ends the tenure before the reacquire

to.n: discipline (C7a): a probe sealed before a release never commits — the release ends the tenure before any reacquire

from.n: admission: an expired lease matches NOBODY — its own holder is rejected before any successor acquires

to.n: admission: a released lease matches NOBODY, its last holder included
